chunks.text: Now, whenever a stack is formed in memory, we talk about another concept, which is Stack Overflow.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: We have talked about all the parameters stored in the call stack at each level.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: For example, if we have made a main function, then A, B, C, 3 parameters will be stored.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: After that, we have made a fun function for recursion.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: If we have made an array in it, then it will be the entire array.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: After that, if we are making an array in the same function, then it will be the entire array.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, in this way, every parameter is made in memory again.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, there are two situations in which many parameters are made at the time of the recursion.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: And the memory consumption of those individual parameters is very high.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Suppose you are making an array of a very large size at every recursion call.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Or there will be a second case in which you are making too many recursion calls.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Too many calls.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: When we make too many recursion calls, then even small parameters are saved in memory many times.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, what happens?

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: One point will come when our stack will be filled with the entire array.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: After that, our memory will not be in place.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: We call that situation Stack Overflow.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Now, because of so many memory usage, there is an error of Stack Overflow.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: That is, in all the call stacks in your memory, we have filled the entire place.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Now, there cannot be any other calls in memory.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: That is why, in those cases, recursion becomes very dangerous.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, whenever we write a recursive function, we should always have a base case.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: We will be able to know from the base case that now we have to stop the recursion.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: When you remove this base case, then Stack Overflow will be there and our program will crash.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Suppose, if I remove this base case in the code and try to run my program.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, what will happen in that case?

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: In that case, there will be no value print.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: My output will not come.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Because every function is being called to the upper level.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: It is never stopping.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: So, after a point, my program crashed.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: It has stopped itself.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: Because, nothing was printed.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
chunks.text: My call stack completely overflowed.

chunks.title: Stack overflow video.mp4
